triggers: the 'TMEM Double-Buffering' technique is being considered on NVIDIA Blackwell (SM100)

payload.goal: Optimization technique for NVIDIA Blackwell (SM100): TMEM Double-Buffering
payload.what: Tensor Memory (TMEM) on Blackwell has 128 rows x 512 columns of 32-bit elements (256 KB per SM). For a standard GEMM with TILE_M=128, TILE_N=256, the accumulator requires 128 x 256 = 32,768 elements, which fits in half the TMEM column space (256 out of 512 columns). The other 256 columns serve as the second buffer.
payload.when: Tensor Memory (TMEM) on Blackwell has 128 rows x 512 columns of 32-bit elements (256 KB per SM).
